Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc-Lko:54777
Court No. - 16
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 10311 of 2023

Applicant :- Bhupendra Kumar Dwivedi
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Avnish Kumar Tiwari
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.
Heard Sri Avnish Kumar Tiwari, the learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Alok Singh, the learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the records.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.421 of 2022, under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 504, 506, 120-B I.P.C., registered at Police Station Kachhauna, District Hardoi.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 18.09.2022 against four persons including the applicant alleging that the informant, his son and his friend purchased some parts of land through sale deeds dated 30.03.2022, 01.04.2022 and 12.04.2022 from Arvind Kumar Singh and Geeta Singh, but later on it transpired that Geeta Singh had already died in the year 2018 and the sale deeds had been executed by some imposters.
Bhupendra Kumar Dwivedi vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

1 4.
In the affidavit filed in support of bail application it has been stated that the applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in the present case.
It has been stated in the affidavit that the applicant has been implicated in the present case merely because he had witnessed the execution of the sale deed along with another witness Pramod.

It has been stated in the affidavit that the informant had entered into an agreement with other three co-accused persons that they will refund the consideration paid by him and the F.I.R. has been lodged after the accused persons failed to perform their part of agreement.

Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that three other named accused persons namely Pravesh Singh, Narendra Kumar and Ravi Pratap Singh have already been enlarged on bail by this court by means of orders dated 17.07.2023, 10.07.2023 and 06.07.2023, passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application Nos.8971 of 2023, 8618 of 2023 and 8329 of 2023 respectively.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application Nos.8971 of 2023, 8618 of 2023 and 8329 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 5. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

6. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the applicant has been implicated in the present case merely because he has witnessed the execution of the alleged sale deed and there is no allegation that he had obtained any benefit out of the alleged transaction; that other three accused persons have already been enlarged on bail by this court; that the applicant has no previous criminal history and he is languishing in jail since 10.04.2023 and without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail in the aforesaid crime.
7. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.

Ram .
